sources.title: Undesirable Memorization in Large Language Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: These challenges motivate the need to further explore memorization in LLMs to effectively tackle the associated challenges. In this paper, we provide an overview of aspects related to memorization, emphasizing the need for further exploration of this topic, thereby balancing model performance with the risks of privacy breaches and ethical concerns.

sources.title: Undesirable Memorization in Large Language Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: In conclusion, while measuring memorization in language models remains a challenging task, techniques like the Exposure Metric and Inference Attacks provide valuable insights into the memorization behavior of these models.
